generation.scope: Each ordinary rank-fifteen presentation has a two-dimensional indexed-isomorphism image of standard regular windows. The projective opposite map on traceless 4×4 matrices gives independent rational trace invariants J2,J3 and a necessary and sufficient comparison using one conjugator, one scalar and the pulled-back matrix product. The two invariants alone are not proved complete.

proof_review.scope: Checked trace-kernel identifications, both directions of the conjugator/product criterion, nonzero Jacobian in characteristic zero and restriction to the regular open subset.

mathematical_computation.scope: Computed normalized right/left null forms, the traceless adjoint map and two invariant differentials modulo 101² in étale surface coordinates. The two-by-two Jacobian determinant is 34 modulo 101 in both presentations.

tex.engine: LuaHBTeX; no overfull boxes, missing glyphs or undefined references

open_mathematics: Use the degree-six insertion builder of verify_rank_fifteen_quadratic_dual.py on the two ordinary surfaces P(n)=0, targeting ranks 36,36,34,34 at each start. Use independent local minors and saturate ordinary denominators to isolate possible Koszul failure points; check higher cut ranks where degree six passes. For indexed equivalence compute the generic degree of (J2,J3) and use the pulled-back product comparison to decide residual coincidences between the sheets.
